title: Pure Doodle Beast
summary: Pure Doodle Beast Dinosaur Tribute-control build supported by the classic Dinosaur starter package (Souleating Oviraptor, Babycerasaurus, Petiteranodon, and Animadorned Archosaur) and Evolzar Xyz bosses. Doodle Beast - Tyranno Tribute Summons itself as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to pop a monster and absorb its ATK.

summary.title: Starters
points: Doodle Beast - Stego (Level 5 EARTH Dinosaur) Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters or only Dinosaurs, then searches Doodlebook - Uh uh uh! and discards 1 card.

Souleating Oviraptor searches or mills any Dinosaur on Normal or Special Summon (including Doodle Beast - Stego, Doodle Beast - Tyranno, or Miscellaneousaurus) and pops a Level 4 or lower Dinosaur on the field to revive another from the GY.

Fossil Dig searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur—Doodle Beast - Stego, Souleating Oviraptor, or Miscellaneousaurus—while Petiteranodon Special Summons Level 5 Doodle Beast - Stego directly from the Deck when destroyed by card effect.

summary.title: Opening: Souleating Oviraptor + Petiteranodon / Stego
steps: Normal Summon Souleating Oviraptor to search Doodle Beast - Tyranno or Doodle Beast - Stego, or discard Miscellaneousaurus to protect your Dinosaurs during the Main Phase and banish it from the GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur.
Pop Petiteranodon or Babycerasaurus with Archosaur or Oviraptor to search Double Evolution Pill and Special Summon Doodle Beast - Stego from the Deck.

Doodle Beast - Stego searches Doodlebook - Uh uh uh! and discards it to the GY; keep Stego on the field and Doodle Beast - Tyranno in hand to Quick-Tribute on the opponent's turn while overlaying Level 4 Dinosaurs into Evolzar Laggia or Dolkka.

summary.title: Quick-Effect Tribute Summon & Doodlebook
summary.text: During either player's Main Phase, Doodle Beast - Tyranno can activate its Quick Effect in the hand to Tribute Summon itself using 1 Dinosaur monster (or 2 non-Dinosaur monsters). When Normal Summoned, Tyranno destroys 1 monster on the field, and if a Doodle Beast monster such as Stego was Tributed for its Tribute Summon, Tyranno gains half the destroyed monster's ATK. Doodlebook - Uh uh uh! negates an attack targeting your Dinosaur and revives a Doodle Beast from the GY on the field, or banishes itself from the GY to search any Level 5 or higher Dinosaur.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Doodle Beast - Tyranno provides repeatable non-targeting monster destruction during the opponent's Main Phase while growing into a high-ATK beatstick.
Evolzar Lars (Rank 6 Xyz) detaches 1 material when made with Dinosaurs as a Quick Effect to negate any face-up card the opponent controls.
Evolzar Laggia and Evolzar Dolkka (Rank 4 Xyz made with two Level 4 Dinosaurs) negate Summons/Spells/Traps or monster activations respectively.
Double Evolution Pill banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from your hand or GY to Special Summon Doodle Beast - Tyranno directly from the hand or Deck, ignoring its summoning conditions.
